builders.angle: LITERAL. Work BRIEF-r21's fix list 1 to 3 in order and exactly as written. Item 1 first: find every hard edge the room shader draws and antialias it to its own screen-space width, measuring each before and after on a Deck-tier crop at 2x nearest-neighbour AND at HIGH so nothing gets softer. Then item 2, then the sweep. The literal angle won round 20.

THE GROUND FIRST. Item 2 is your round: make the room's floor and the combatants' floor line ONE plane, in every wing -- decide from the five judged fights whether the camera rigs (each region's cam in fx/atmosphere.js) should bring the floor up, or the stage should bring the line down, and justify it with measurements of where the floor meets the line in each. Give every combatant a shadow in the room's own light and a flier a shadow under it. Then item 1, the lines, because a floor you can now see must not stair-step.

THE INKED LINE. The samples are drawn: every edge is a crisp, smooth ink line. Treat item 1 as drawing, not filtering -- rebuild the room shader's line primitives (strings, rails, balusters, flutes, mouldings, bars) as analytic distance-field strokes with a pixel-width-aware edge, so they read as ink at 0.8 upscaled and at 1.0 alike, and never as blur. Then item 2's floor, then the sweep.
